name: su1-cn-tower-north
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, a = C.worldFromLatLon(43.6426, -79.3871), b = C.worldFromLatLon(43.7000, -79.4000); app.teleportTo(a.x, a.z + 60, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [a.x - (b.x - a.x) / Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z) * 140, 340, a.z - (b.z - a.z) / Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z) * 140], look: [b.x, 0, b.z], fov: 60 }); })()
